    Which actress left her Oscar in the restroom?
    An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
    AI Overview
    Meryl Streep famously left her first Oscar in the bathroom during the 1980 Academy Awards ceremony after winning for Kramer vs. Kramer, leaving the statuette on a counter before retrieving it, while Kate Winslet and Emma Thompson are known for keeping their Oscars in their bathrooms as decorative items.
     
    Meryl Streep's Incident 
    • When: 1980, after winning Best Supporting Actress for Kramer vs. Kramer.
    • What Happened: In the excitement of the night, she placed the Oscar on a bathroom counter and forgot it, but thankfully, retrieved it before leaving.
    Other Actresses & Their Bathrooms
    • Kate Winslet:
      Keeps her Oscar in the bathroom, encouraging guests to pick it up and practice acceptance speeches. 
    • Emma Thompson:
      Stores her Oscars in the bathroom, finding them too flashy for other spots and even placing mirrors nearby for guests to take selfies with them.

      What was the most controversial best actor win?
      Marlon Brando's rejection (1973)

      When Marlon Brando won best actor for The Godfather, he decided not to show up. Instead, he sent Sacheen Littlefeather, an actress and activist, to turn down the award on his behalf. She was supposed to read a 15-page speech, but was unable to do so because of time constraints.      3 days ago

      Did Michael B. Jordan win an award for Sinners?
      An AI Overview is not available for this searchCan't generate an AI overview right now. Try again later.
      AI Overview
      Michael B. Jordan has recently won major awards for his dual role in the film Sinners, including the 2026 Actor Award for Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Leading Role, alongside wins for his castmates and the film itself at the same ceremony, significantly boosting its Oscar momentum. He also won Outstanding Actor at the NAACP Image Awards for the film and secured a BAFTA nomination for Best Leading Actor, solidifying his strong showing in the 2026 awards season. 
      This video shows Michael B. Jordan's acceptance speech at the Actor Awards:
      55s
      Netflix
      YouTube · Mar 1, 2026
      Key Wins & Nominations for Sinners (2026 Awards Season):
      • The Actor Awards (formerly SAG Awards):
        • Best Male Actor in a Motion Picture/Outstanding Performance by a Male Actor in a Leading Role: for Sinners. 
        • Best Ensemble Cast in a Motion Picture: (with the cast). 
      • NAACP Image Awards:
        • Outstanding Actor in a Motion Picture: for Sinners. 
      • BAFTA Film Awards (Nominee):
        • Nominated for Best Leading Actor. 
      Significance of the Wins:
      • The Actor Award win, presented by Viola Davis, was seen as a major upset and a huge boost for the film's Best Picture chances at the Oscars, given the voting bloc. 
      • Sinners, directed by Ryan Coogler, swept multiple categories at the NAACP Image Awards and led the Oscar nominations, making Jordan's performances (playing twins Smoke & Stack) a central part of its success.
